missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Баня' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Рядом с домом' marks the location next to the house.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Баню' is the accusative direct object of 'топим'. 'В субботу' sets the time for heating the bathhouse.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Бани' is the genitive form after 'после', marking what the tea follows. A classic Russian bathhouse ritual.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Баню' is accusative after 'в' showing motion into the bathhouse. 'Вечером' gives the time of the visit.

missions.phrase: В бане очень жарко и хорошо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Бане' is the prepositional form after 'в', marking where it is hot. The impersonal 'жарко' describes the inside conditions.

missions.phrase: Дедушка идёт к бане с веником.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Бане' is dative after 'к', marking the bathhouse as the goal of motion. 'С веником' adds the traditional birch besom.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Баней' is instrumental after 'за', placing the birch tree behind the bathhouse. 'Высокая' agrees with the feminine subject.

missions.phrase: Наша баня очень тёплая и уютная.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Баня' is the nominative subject. 'Тёплая' and 'уютная' are agreeing feminine adjectives describing it, joined by 'и'.

missions.phrase: В деревне есть две старые бани.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. 'Бани' takes the genitive singular form after 'две', while 'старые' uses the plural adjective. A typical counting pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Бани' is the accusative plural object of 'построили', identical to the nominative for this inanimate noun. 'Новые' agrees in plural.
